Introduction
Admission Inquiry Drs. Kiran and Pallavi Patel Global University Internal Quality Assurance Cell Message from Director "Greetings from the Internal Quality Assurance Cell (IQAC) of Drs. Kiran & Pallavi Patel Global University (KPGU). The IQAC has been established with the vision to build and sustain an environment for holistic growth of academic excellence, quality research, innovation activity, and systematic review of study programs.
